votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of Tuesday, March 16, 2021.
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from March 16, 2021.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B1 through B4 to a future Consent Agenda.
votes.description: The Council closed public hearings on four grant applications (RMHIDTA, School-Age Program Summer Expansion, State Homeland Security Program, and YouthCity Summer Snack Program) and referred them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Resolution 28 of 2021.
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution adding the honorary street name 'Pastor France Davis Way' on the block of Harvard Avenue between State Street and Main Street, recognizing Reverend France A. Davis for his over forty years of community service.

The Council adopted an ordinance closing and vacating a portion of a City-owned alley at approximately 740 South Goshen Street to allow the adjacent property owner to incorporate the alleyway into their lot.

The Council adopted an ordinance vacating five unimproved City-owned alleys and six unimproved City-owned streets within Rosewood Park at approximately 1400 North 1200 West to allow property consolidation for future improvement projects.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 48 of 2021, with added language requiring a hearing officer to make reasonable efforts to respond to a stay request within 10 days of the appeal being deemed complete, with specific provisions on presumed denial if not decided within 10 days and no stay for incomplete or late appeals.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending the zoning ordinance's appeals chapter to clarify administrative decision appeal procedures, align with state law, and add specific timelines for stay request determinations by the Appeals Hearing Officer.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 27 of 2021, adopting the Capital Improvement Program project-specific allocations for Fiscal Year 2021-2022 as shown on the attached Exhibit A Funding Log.
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution approving project-specific funding allocations for the City's Capital Improvement Program for FY2021-2022, covering construction, purchase, or renovation of physical structures with a useful life of five or more years.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Stephen Meyer as Director of 911 Dispatch.
votes.description: The Council approved the Mayor's appointment of Stephen Meyer as Director of the 911 Dispatch Department under the advice and consent process.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for the USO Airport Military Lounge lease fee waiver resolution and the 2020 Salt Lake City Street Lighting Master Plan ordinance.
